cells.value: Any individual, company, or organization that supplies parts, equipment, or material for the work described in this specification.
Liquids that are not generally corrosive, but are piped in corrosion resistant alloys (CRA) to provide a clean environment, such as fine water mist, wet air systems, lube oil and seal oil systems.
Crude oil, produced water, seawater, methanol, ethanol, triethylene glycol (TEG), and any other liquids with a corrosive or erosive effect on piping components.
A value applied to the specified minimum yield strength to arrive at an allowable design stress.
Air, nitrogen, miscible injectant, or natural gas with no free water at any operating or upset condition.
Unless otherwise specified, low temperature is defined as -50°F (-46°C).
Natural Gas Liquids (NGL), Liquid Petroleum Gas (LPG), and other liquids with no free water and no corrosive effect on piping components.
The term "Supplier" as used in this specification shall include those who have contracted to provide the specified materials.
Heating and cooling glycol, heat transfer fluids.
Natural gas with free water under normal operating conditions; natural gas with CO2 and free water under operating or upset conditions. Wet gas is assumed to be highly corrosive.
